headline: Oracle May Cut Up To 30,000 Jobs To Fund Massive AI Data-Centre Expansion: Report
summary: Oracle plans to cut 20,000 to 30,000 jobs and sell parts of its business to help fund a $156 billion AI data-centre expansion, according to a report. The company is reportedly seeking $45-50 billion in 2026 for cloud capacity growth amid financing challenges.
why: Oracle is a major enterprise software and cloud infrastructure provider, and its heavy AI data-centre spending and funding strategy are closely watched by investors.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: The reported job cuts and asset sales are Oracle's own measures to fund its AI data-centre spending.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report points to financing pressure from pulled-back bank lending and a large AI data-centre build-out, which may prompt investors to reassess Oracle's funding and cash flow.
